question: Which new sketch constraint did Onshape add in its October 30, 2026 update?

The release notes excerpt mentions "smoother G3 sketch transitions" [1], and forum commenters describe this as "G3 sketch constraints" and "G3 splines in sketcher" [1]. That is the closest match, but the excerpt doesn't state how it is applied or what the constraint is called in the UI. The full changelog, which the post says contains the detailed list, isn't included in the sources, so I can't give menu paths or steps.

studyNotes.focus: The question asks which specific new sketch constraint Onshape added in its October 30, 2026 update, which the sources do not name.

keyPoints.text: The October 30, 2026 Onshape update (rel-1.223) highlights custom standard content libraries, smoother G3 sketch transitions, faster simulations with rigid parts, and a full set of product renders in one pass.

Commenters on the October 30 update mention G3 splines in the sketcher as a new addition, but the post itself only refers to 'G3 sketch transitions' and 'G3 sketch splines' without naming a constraint type.

The October 9, 2026 update (rel-1.222) covered asynchronous simulation in assemblies, reflection analysis image library, CAM Studio improvements and mobile AI Advisor on iOS, but no sketch constraint.
Onshape's Constraint manager tool helps identify and resolve sketch constraint conflicts, but it is a longstanding feature and not identified as new in the October 30 update.
